title: Assemble the SO101 arm's elbow: servo, four tab screws, forearm, eight horn screws (two Frankas, operational-space control)
text: Put the SO101 arm's elbow together with the screwdriver: seat the servo in the upper arm and fasten it with the four small screws, then fit the forearm onto the servo and fasten it with the eight larger screws.
success: Success: all twelve screws are driven home and locked, filling every hole (any screw in any hole of its size), the servo sits in the upper arm's pocket, and the forearm sits on the servo's output horn (at any elbow angle).
